title: VFX Mega Pack R0 — Proposed Action-to-VFX Mappings
description: Defines the required visual family, tactical presentation requirement, processing type, and change classification for all 60 hero actions. Does NOT claim that verified source assets exist. All Mega Pack candidate IDs are UNASSIGNED_PENDING_R1. R1 inventory is blocked until commercial files are locally available. Source root: <MEGA_PACK_ROOT> (configurable, outside public/assets/).
r1BlockReason: Mega Pack commercial files not yet locally available. R1 inventory and indexing cannot proceed until purchase and local import.
